{{Top|leg}}
A '''sleeper mine''' was a type of drone unit utilized by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the live fire readiness exercise [[Operation Hammerblow]]. During the engagement, a sleeper mine destroyed an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] from [[Blackfire Flight]].
